deal.text: *Goal: survive.* Every pile is a life.

Pick a pile, then *swipe* to guess the next card against that pile's *top card*:
↑ higher
↓ lower
sideways = *same*
Or tap the pile and use the buttons on the left.

Every guess draws the next card from *the deck*.
Right → the pile grows
Wrong → the pile dies
Beat the *whole deck* before every pile is gone.
Call *Same* when you expect an equal card. A correct Same charges this *shield*, protecting you from your next incorrect guess.
This strip shows *what's left in the deck*. Hold on a number to see how many cards are higher and lower than it. Tap on the deck to see all the cards.
